scope: Spline ecband_el loose acceptance only. 3D Bayesian phi_h in the copy of fits/spline/ecband_el/loose/fit_copy.root, Q2-y 1-17, 452 histograms. The file has rdf, mdf, gdf, Background, and Bayesian histograms and no RC_Bayesian, BC_RC_Bayesian, Bin, or 5D histograms. Those families were not created. No publication. The source fit, the budget, and the shared Phi_h guides were not edited. This copy does not replace the source, so the source stays in the budget. The destination did not already contain refinement_note.json and fit.json, so this is not a resume.
start_mode: manual. start=auto: the 3D spline B windows selected by these histograms have median width 0.0153 and 428 of 452 are narrower than 0.05, and the C windows have median width 0.0070 with 445 of 452 narrower than 0.05, so they can pin a fit. The run-local guide started as Phi_h_Fit_Parameters_Initialize.py. --use_spline_init was not passed.
changed: Pass 1 used the manual baseline on all 452 histograms. It improved 6 and made 24 worse. The manual window, or the second-pass half-width around a bad start, pulled bins off this histogram's cosine. The worst stored miss that pass 1 did not fix was (Q2_y_Bin_13)-(z_pT_Bin_10), and the worst pass-1 regression was (Q2_y_Bin_3)-(z_pT_Bin_16). (Q2_y_Bin_1)-(z_pT_Bin_8) Pass 1 moved it only from B=-0.045000 to B=-0.060411, collapsed C to 0, and changed chi-squared from 44.789 to 43.701. That is still short of this histogram's cosine. Pass 2 put 51 starts on each histogram's own unconstrained cosine, opened only the limits that excluded that cosine, and turned off the second-pass half-width when it was narrower than the parameter error. It refit Q2-y 1 through 16. Q2-y 17 was not given new keys and did not move. JSON still has 452 bins. 31 histograms have a lower chi-squared than the stored fit and none is worse (largest increase 0.001). (1, 8) is kept at B=-0.124088, statistical error 0.034597, C=-0.044416, error 0.031824, chi-squared 39.479, NDF 13, status completed, phi 60-300, 16 histogram bins inside the TF1 range. The stored B=-0.045 was the second-pass edge of a first-pass limit at -0.03, not the cosine. It is not pulled to the nominal B=-0.125184.
left_bins: No 5D family is in this file, so nothing was left from a 3D-versus-5D disagreement. Large nominal-minus-variation shifts that already match this histogram were not moved onto the nominal value. (Q2_y_Bin_5)-(z_pT_Bin_3) stays at B=-0.19739 versus nominal -0.15443. (Q2_y_Bin_3)-(z_pT_Bin_3) is kept at its own cosine B=-0.17202 rather than the nominal -0.13868. (Q2_y_Bin_7)-(z_pT_Bin_35) stays at B=-0.26495 rather than the nominal -0.24532. Excluded sector pairs were not put back into this comparison. No comparison was filled with zero. The source was not removed from the budget, and fit-parameter errors were not added to the systematic uncertainty.
